authority.base_equipment: ../equipment-v1/weapons.json and armor.json remain authoritative; references resolve by stable ID and JSON pointer
authority.timing: ../items-v1/common-rules.json#/weapon_timing_extension overrides old full snapshot wording; ../player-combat-v1/player-combat-rules.json governs aerial use and per-emission positions
authority.names_counts_rates: assistant proposals; EV-030 is continuation not per-parameter user approval

coordinate_contract.art_axes: rig_local u right and v up in cm around the corresponding primary pivot; image_px uses the unified production-plan.json origin/axes/pivot/trim/single-mirror contract; never equate local v with world Z alone
coordinate_contract.coordinate_metadata_authority_ref: production-plan.json unified image_px and rig_local coordinate contract; authoritative for pixel origin, conversion, trim offset and one-time left-facing mirror
coordinate_contract.sprite_root: ground projection at actor X/Y; character visual rises by actual Z; ground_shadow remains at ground projection
coordinate_contract.same_depth_cross_layer: body far arm/weapon behind torso and near arm/weapon in front; switch masks at declared pose crossover markers; no depth displacement from layer order
coordinate_contract.whole_actor_sort: root pipeline sorts actors by actual ground Y with the formal far/near projection; local limb layers never reorder whole characters by weapon tip
coordinate_contract.legacy_prototype: formal positive Y projection/sort is a future migration; do not modify legacy DungeonHUD Ground=510+Y*.48 or claim it already matches

events.accepted_start: start pose from already frozen full effective W/A/R and subwindow schedule; no new damage/resource snapshot
events.lock: source 40% of frozen windup; lock marker/pose reads real acceptance; no direction autoaim, no early glow that implies guarantee
events.emit: use each actual emission origin/height and locked direction plus intrinsic source spread; no old same-Y line if actor moved Y between emissions
events.active_subhit: pose reaches source subwindow; no extra hits from trail geometry
events.hit_resolved: only accepted result gives target material contact; include source damage zone/aggregate/penetration result
events.status_applied_or_ended: status cue follows actual accepted status life; rejection no fake freezing/poise break
events.action_end: return idle when source full recovery ends; never retain blocking pose as input lock
events.interrupted: discard only presentation for interrupted action; logic decides reservations, cooldown and airborne slot; already-created projectiles follow original lifetime
events.inventory_commit: replace visible equipped instance only on actual D04 commit; old visuals remain before commit
events.trait_start_or_end: armor cue reads accepted conditional trait state, no local frame timer grants effect

simulation_event_contract.deduplication_key: RunID + actor_instance_id + AttackID_or_OperationID + event_kind + event_serial + subhit_or_emission_ID_if_present
simulation_event_contract.many_targets_one_subhit: coalesce presentation hitstop once; retain distinct legal contact points at bounded root FX budget; do not stack target count into hold length
simulation_event_contract.same_shot_shotgun: consume source per-target aggregated shot receipt; cosmetic rays never collide again
simulation_event_contract.low_render_rate: process all event receipts once; coalesce already happened subhits/emissions into a bounded composite flash/sound summary when necessary; no promise each emission occupies a unique rendered frame
simulation_event_contract.late_event_policy: seek current absolute phase; do not queue new-looking attacks or projectile emissions after original recovery/end; delayed cosmetic contact may be omitted/coalesced without dropping authoritative outcomes
simulation_event_contract.pause_policy: only real simulation pause freezes logic; live UI02/07/08 do not pause; presentation pause cannot modify any timer

phase_binding.effective_speed_rule_ref: ../equipment-v2/stat-definitions.json action_speed_pct: clamp and subwindow floor remain source owned
phase_binding.clip_sampling: sample normalized authored curves against current absolute effective phase; source frame number is not a simulation timestamp
phase_binding.short_window_policy: preserve event order and subhit IDs when a render frame skips a window; sample contact pose for cosmetic event then current phase without adding simulation dwell
phase_binding.lock_readability: within existing windup use hand/shoulder settle around true lock; may use subtle cue event but cannot extend short windup to meet a minimum animation frame count
phase_binding.cancel_readability: before-lock reverse cancel follows source acceptance, never a universal jump/dodge cancel; fixed windup is not hold-to-charge
phase_binding.root_motion_authority: actor XY/Z changes only from source movement/displacement; exported in-place animation root has no authority
phase_binding.turning: face from legal source rules; after lock no visual auto-turn to hit target
phase_binding.critical_hit: one attack crit result in snapshot; stronger contact cue only on actual legal hit, not a second crit roll

presentation_hitstop.source_ref: ../equipment-v1/00-共同规则.md and each weapon audio_vfx
presentation_hitstop.scope: rendered contact pose only; optional actor-only cosmetic hold; ground root and simulation pose continue real positions
presentation_hitstop.overlapping_contacts: take one capped remaining cosmetic hold, never sum or extend a group by number of targets
presentation_hitstop.next_critical_event: immediately end cosmetic hold on next real emission/subhit/lock/phase_change/interruption/death/action_end; re-sample current absolute phase without replay
presentation_hitstop.phase_change_scope: authoritative action-segment transition, including windup/active/recovery, or an authoritative Boss-stage transition when it occurs; presentation cannot create or delay either transition
presentation_hitstop.socket_safety: logic emission origins come from unfrozen combat pose/authoritative attachment, not frozen rendered bone; emission pose overrides hold so muzzle can coincide with actual origin
presentation_hitstop.reduced_motion: root accessibility can suppress cosmetic hold/flash without suppressing authoritative events

families.name: 小刀
families.grip: 单手贴肋；双匕按逐件双手；低重心不改变身体高度或受击体
families.anticipation: 短收腕显出刀尖；双匕两手分离；不作重兵器大绕肩
families.strike: 刀尖短伸和局部腕旋；主线窄直，不能变成宽扇
families.recovery: 快回肋侧，但仍完整保留源后摇；双击间隙不开放取消
families.silhouette: 短刃、短护手和空手/第二刃均清楚
families.sound_direction: 细短风切、皮革摩擦；接触点小而锐
families.hit_and_miss: 正数命中才接触音与点火星；落空只有风切和收手，不播钻甲音
families.source_timing: equipment-v1/weapons.json per instance + D03 accepted-start effective timeline

families.name: 大刀
families.grip: 双手短至长柄，配重靠刀头；刀刃与上肢保持分层
families.anticipation: 先沉肩扭胯，刀头稍滞后；不能在前摇临时加蓄力等待
families.strike: 腰带宽刃作前向横扫，惯性由肩胯传到刃端；低扫另作俯身
families.recovery: 刃先停、膝缓冲、身体再回正；不把全部重量交给屏幕震动
families.silhouette: 宽背刀头和弯/阔刃；不与细直重剑同剪影
families.sound_direction: 中低频厚风切、刀身余震和承重落脚
families.hit_and_miss: 合法接触按源轻重停顿；扫空仍完整收势，只保风声，无命中震响
families.source_timing: equipment-v1/weapons.json per instance + D03 accepted-start effective timeline

families.name: 单手剑
families.grip: 一手短柄；另一手平衡；刺剑侧身，弯剑指护外展
families.anticipation: 肩臂收势短于重剑；刺剑直线预备，弯剑准备返刃
families.strike: 军剑斜斩、刺剑送尖、弯剑斩返；家族内部不是同一横砍换皮
families.recovery: 收腕/回肘恢复，双斩首段后不回待机
families.silhouette: 短柄单手轮廓与留空的副手
families.sound_direction: 中频短金属鸣；刺击细尖、弯剑两触点一实一轻
families.hit_and_miss: 剑身风切与目标材质接触分开；落空不播金属碰撞
families.source_timing: equipment-v1/weapons.json per instance + D03 accepted-start effective timeline

families.name: 重剑
families.grip: 双手长柄，直厚剑身；肩线与刃线清楚
families.anticipation: 高举或肩侧蓄势，膝胯先承重；长锋空区不画成发光实墙
families.strike: 窄面重劈/远端斜劈/双砸；剑尖落点明确，绝不新增冲击波
families.recovery: 剑停后膝缓冲、拔回和起身；所有后摇继续按源走完
families.silhouette: 长直厚刃、长柄，区别大刀横向阔头
families.sound_direction: 低频风压与短深金属触点；双砸保持两个逻辑节拍
families.hit_and_miss: 命中才局部震响；落空可有无伤害地面轻尘，但不播敌人受击/破韧
families.source_timing: equipment-v1/weapons.json per instance + D03 accepted-start effective timeline

families.name: 长枪
families.grip: 双手导杆，前手作导向、后手送力；细长杆保持直线
families.anticipation: 后手小收、枪尖对线，动作紧而读得出；不以横扫当默认
families.strike: 枪尖高速直送，主攻速度、窄纵深、远端距离同时可读；撩刺另有低起弧
families.recovery: 短促收杆显露空档；三刺有三个峰值，保护/落空不省略后续
families.silhouette: 枪尖细长、杆尾配重，握区较暗，主攻空区不发亮
families.sound_direction: 尖细破风、杆身短回弹；接触是点刺音而非斧砍
families.hit_and_miss: 刺空只留细直残影；命中出点状火星，不能让杆身整段像连续伤害
families.source_timing: equipment-v1/weapons.json per instance + D03 accepted-start effective timeline

families.name: 戟
families.grip: 双手长杆；侧刃/倒钩/月刃与尾帽独立标记
families.anticipation: 换握可见，戟刃不会穿掌；长戟刺扫准备与短半握区别
families.strike: 刺与扫/钩斩/刃尾连击分别换形状，间隙暗下，不画一整块包络
families.recovery: 回收和换握完整保留；牵引只跟实际目标位移回执
families.silhouette: 枪尖、侧刃、尾帽三点；倒钩朝前侧有可辨反勾
families.sound_direction: 刺细扫宽、钩回收金属颤音、杆尾闷顶
families.hit_and_miss: 合法牵引才接地拖移；空钩回收无抓取线，Boss免位移仍可接触伤害
families.source_timing: equipment-v1/weapons.json per instance + D03 accepted-start effective timeline

families.name: 弩
families.grip: 弓臂水平、弩槽与枪口不同；袖弩抬腕，其余双手承托
families.anticipation: 提弩/压肩拉紧弦，不出现火药蓄焰
families.strike: 实际发射事件放弦和矢尾；袖弩三压逐发，重弩躯干后坐
families.recovery: 收弩后摇与独立上弦装填分开，不能用绞盘转完伪造加弹
families.silhouette: 横向弓臂、弩槽、绞盘/轮仓；与枪管差异优先
families.sound_direction: 弦啪、木机和齿轮；禁止枪口爆鸣/火药焰
families.hit_and_miss: 飞矢实际碰撞才目标/墙接触；空射有弦音无命中停顿，绳钩失败按真实生命周期收回
families.source_timing: equipment-v1/weapons.json per instance + D03 accepted-start effective timeline

families.name: 手枪
families.grip: 短管单手为主，决斗铳双手托腕；枪口位置独立
families.anticipation: 举腕、压稳，固定前摇不变为按住蓄力
families.strike: 枪口焰跟实际射击，腕后坐；双响每发有独立事件
families.recovery: 腕回位与真实装填分开；后撤技能严格在源指定阶段
families.silhouette: 转轮、并排双管、长单管三种短兵器轮廓
families.sound_direction: 清脆短火药响，双响节拍不合成散弹齐鸣
families.hit_and_miss: 击发音不等于命中音；飞弹命中才接触；空弹拒绝不假播放发射/消耗
families.source_timing: equipment-v1/weapons.json per instance + D03 accepted-start effective timeline

families.name: 霰弹枪
families.grip: 双手顶肩，短粗/长收束/鼓仓持握不同
families.anticipation: 肩胯顶住，长管贴腮，低重心只是姿势
families.strike: 瞬时射线齐射后坐；短弹迹仅展示实际射线截点，绝不生成第二套伤害丸
families.recovery: 回肩沉管、逐腔或鼓仓装填；双枪技能依两个发射回执
families.silhouette: 粗短枪口、细长收束管、鼓腹仓一眼可分
families.sound_direction: 低而短喷响；一枪多丸不叠成多重炸响
families.hit_and_miss: 同枪同目标按聚合回执一次接触表现；扇面空处不能铺满命中火星；铅柱技能用实体单弹
families.source_timing: equipment-v1/weapons.json per instance + D03 accepted-start effective timeline

families.name: 步枪
families.grip: 双手枪托架肩；栓机、三连枪机、刺刀清楚
families.anticipation: 长线稳枪；定射站定用脚姿表达，不添加瞄准吸附
families.strike: 单发/固定三连各随真实发射；刺刀技能切到独立近战姿态
families.recovery: 拉栓退壳属于射击后摇，补弹属于装填；不能混成一次免费补仓
families.silhouette: 长枪管木托/铜三段机/短管刺刀三类
families.sound_direction: 单发长响、三连有规律、刺刀只有刃风接触
families.hit_and_miss: 每发击发与弹着分离；栓机落空仍拉栓，刺刀不出枪口焰或退壳
families.source_timing: equipment-v1/weapons.json per instance + D03 accepted-start effective timeline

families.name: 法杖
families.grip: 杖头、握点、施法手分开；火灯/霜刻/双针不同
families.anticipation: 火球聚小焰、冰片短指引、电针夹腕对线；不能统一旋转法阵
families.strike: 火球慢弹、冰片双弹、雷线瞬时；地面火线/霜扇与贯闪另用技能动作
families.recovery: 收杖和专注不足反馈不混同；无弹匣装填动画
families.silhouette: 灯笼、冰棱刻头、音叉双针；魔光不淹没手和尖端
families.sound_direction: 火呼啸、冰脆双声、干短电音；不用火药爆鸣
families.hit_and_miss: 主攻不暗示固有状态；状态仅真实生效回执出现；落空只有施法/飞行/到期消散无命中音
families.source_timing: equipment-v1/weapons.json per instance + D03 accepted-start effective timeline

component_strategy.basis: one shared character body/locomotion scaffold + eleven family pose bases + per-weapon primary corrections + thirty-three secondary motion profiles + armor skins and type deformation sets
component_strategy.not_equipment_cross_product: do not paint a complete animation set for every 33 weapon x 12 armor combination
component_strategy.two_hand_crossovers: weapon is one rigid asset with near/mid/far masks driven by pose; two visible hands follow primary/secondary grip markers, not two copies of full weapon
component_strategy.exception_cost: dual knives, asymmetric hook/tail exchanges, shoulder cannon recoil and long robe folds need authored corrective pieces; count in root budget after proof, not blanket reuse
component_strategy.compatibility_scope: all 11 families x all 12 skins need future pose sampling review, not 132 hand-painted full clip sets

export_contract.source_format: layered editable art plus optional Blender .blend render source; no mandatory paid skeletal plugin
delivery_files: PNG RGBA8 sRGB color parts on transparent background
motion.json normalized pose curves and source-timing references
sockets.json named local coordinates/orientations and facing variants
preview_contact_sheet.png only when assets are later created and archived per root media README
export_contract.source_editability: retain rig/parts/key poses; baking at source rate does not replace continuous timing/event metadata
export_contract.canvas_and_trim: actor/body-armor layers share the aligned character logical canvas and ground pivot, with trim offset stored for every part/frame; a detached weapon has its own canvas, primary grip pivot and parent attachment transform, not a copied actor ground pivot; never snap each frame center to bounding box
export_contract.coordinate_conversion_ref: production-plan.json unified image_px/rig_local coordinate contract; apply its pivot, trim and one-time mirror conversion rather than a second local convention
export_contract.scale_units: attachment metadata in logical cm with explicit source-pixels-per-cm; dimensions measured in later asset intake, no guessed new gameplay muzzle offsets
export_contract.required_common_markers_scope: assembled character visual rig, not every texture or detached weapon component; armor layers inherit the rig ground/feet/hands and store their aligned canvas offsets
export_contract.detached_weapon_marker_scope: primary grip pivot and parent attachment transform plus conditional weapon-specific markers; no foot markers or actor ground pivot required on the weapon component

conditional_markers.two_hand_or_dual_weapon: grip_secondary plus actual near/far hand assignment
conditional_markers.melee: weapon_tip; polearm blade/tail variants also weapon_tail
conditional_markers.visible_ejection_only: ejection_cosmetic; omitted if no casing animation

export_contract.marker_ownership: logical attachment reference is combat data/approved rig; cosmetic offsets and recoil never move damage origin or range; validate current emission pose against origin receipt
export_validation: all required IDs and paired hand grips resolve
alpha edges and trim preserve pivot
near/far masks have no duplicated whole weapon
contact/emit poses align source geometry under projection
frame-rate change does not add/remove source events
left/right and all armor types retain silhouette/feet
export_contract.import_paths_suggestion: Content/Art/Characters/Player/Equipment/<stable_ID>/<version>; source-assets/art/player/equipment/<stable_ID>/<version>; files are proposals not created assets

left_right_rules.default: mirror pose/layout X by facing while preserving stable IDs; gameplay facing is source authority
explicit_exceptions: KNF-002 dual knives keep distinct blade length and real hand assignment after near/far swap
HAL-002 hook stays correct cutting-facing orientation; separate authored left pose if naive flip overlaps torso
HAL-003 blade/tail swap uses declared crossover markers, not weapon duplicate
PST/SGN/RFL ejection side may use cosmetic opposite-side part; ejecta never become attack projectile
ARM-LGT-002 one-sided shoulder and ARM-ROB-002 asymmetrical hems need separate near/far layer maps
STF head runes remain readable and electrical endpoints follow actual directional emission
left_right_rules.push_pull: visual displacement reads source actual signed facing result; mirroring never manually applies a second sign

aerial_landing_and_equip.air_primary: D02 one accepted primary per takeoff, same weapon full timeline/cost; lower body uses real air pose while upper family pose runs; ground-only secondary/reload/dodge stay illegal
aerial_landing_and_equip.landing: switch lower body to legal landing locomotion pose without ending/restarting attack, spending/refunding extra resources, resetting subhit IDs, or spawning ground slam; ground shadow stays anchored
aerial_landing_and_equip.ground_effects: only source ground attacks project to ground; aerial attacks do not acquire automatic downward aiming or area on landing
aerial_landing_and_equip.weapon_switch: read real D02 switch action and complete; no visible equip commit earlier than logical switch; all existing bullets/skill cooldown/magazine persist
aerial_landing_and_equip.inventory_equip: read D04 OperationID start/commit/cancel; old held/armor instance remains before commit, new skin appears on same successful commit; cancelled previews never become visible equipped state
aerial_landing_and_equip.blend_boundary: cosmetic crossfade may soften commit but must not show an active new muzzle or both equipped weapon effects; all gameplay uses actual current instance
aerial_landing_and_equip.interrupt_or_death: release animation state without granting invulnerability/get-up; break overlay only on actual poise break; dead body presentation does not end still-valid projectile outcomes
aerial_landing_and_equip.trait_compatibility: ARM-LGT-002 reads start locomotion, not landing frame; armor recovery/standing traits read existing logical status, never animation idleness

static_design_checks: unique 11 families and 33 actual weapon IDs
every weapon has distinct primary and matching named secondary
all 12 armor IDs/types and every family compatibility referenced
no copied new base timing/damage/range authority
runtime_checks_not_performed: frame-skip or low-render-rate burst receipts do not double fire
extreme allowed action/reload speed and live UI transitions preserve source timeline
all 33 primaries and 33 secondaries both facings with four armor deformation types
shortest knife/longest spear visual reach/inner empty zones match source precise geometry
actual projectile emission position during Y move/jump/cosmetic hitstop
shotgun ray aggregation and delayed flight contact differ correctly
landing/interruption/equip cancel have no extra attacks/refills or wrong skin
long weapons/robes/hook cross-layer silhouette and floor warnings remain visible

known_limits: No sprites, rigs, animations, audio or UE assets created; fps and component plan are assistant proposals
Formal positive-Y art projection is not yet migrated into the existing prototype
Visual readability and compatibility cannot be certified without asset sampling and a running-game check
66 primary/secondary motion profile IDs are design references, not 66 completed clips; source/reuse correction cost remains root budget responsibility
